title: Not what it used to be
body:
Two years ago I would have 5 starred this app - I even used to pay for premium for about four years - but the amount of changes and "improvements" that have been brought to this application have completely changed the way it used to function and have forced a number of drastic changes without giving us proper settings to disable the new changes. 

For example, you used to just be able to sort your tasks into any order without having to deal with setting a time for each task, but now every time you move something around or say, push something to next week, the app automatically assigns it a date and time that I don't get to set the default for, and most importantly, I can't disable it. Moving a task to tomorrow WILL put it in your calendar whether you like it or not, requiring you to manually disable each one. There are a number of other similar minor but massively inconvenient and forced changes are at the core of this 1 star. Another would be the way they force default list orders on you. It used to work perfectly, then once we were used to how it worked, they just changed everything without even giving us a choice.

If the developers give us a sorely overdue overhaul of the application settings and give us the ability to make things function as they always did going back the last two years, I'll come back and fix this review, hell, even pay for premium again, but it's doubtful that they will even see this given how non existent their premium "priority" support was. In the meantime I'll just be using a pen and a pad of paper because it's so much less inconvenient.
